snippet.title: Just Have a Think
snippet.description:
This channel seeks to  understand the issues that face our civilisation in the 21st Century and focusses on the potential solutions that will save as many lives as possible and hopefully bring about a greater level of equality in the world. The channel is not a debating forum about whether Human Induced Climate Change is a real phenomenon or not. If that's what you're after then I can highly recommend chat forums on Social Media, where people on both sides of the argument go round and round in circles achieving precisely nothing at all.

That is a mug's game. And it's not my game. 

Anyway, outside of those caveats, I do try to keep it light and humorous wherever possible, so I hope you enjoy the content. 

Oh..and me... Dave Borlace. Born 1969. BSc in Technology from the Open University in the UK. After a 30 year career in People and Project Management,  I now work full time on the channel thanks to the amazing folks who support me on Patreon at   patreon.com/justhaveathink

snippet.title: Think School

The Indian education system is broken  built to produce workers, not thinkers. At Think School, we’re on a mission to change that.

We deliver world-class practical education through our Business & Geopolitical Case Studies actionable breakdowns of how companies win, why businesses fail, and how global forces shape economies. Lessons you can immediately apply.

We also host the Indian Business Podcast  India’s top business podcast where industry leaders and policymakers decode strategy, business growth and leadership. Each episode is a masterclass designed for clarity.

Think School is a movement to redefine how India learns.
If you believe education should create leaders, not followers subscribe and join the movement.
